gist: Outer cover of the bound register: «Журналъ исходящихъ бумагъ по Ежегоднику на 1899 г.»; top label «Ф-дъ Дирекціи Императорскихъ Театр.»; ЦГИАЛ label Фондъ 497, Опись 18, Ед. хр. № 190.
why: Identifies the file: the editorial office's own register of papers going OUT, started 1899.

gist: Title page: «Ф-дъ Дирекція императорскихъ театровъ. СПб. Контора. Журналъ исходящихъ бумагъ по журналу "Ежегодникъ императорскихъ театровъ" 1899 г.» with «Начато 1899 г. Окончено —» at lower right.
why: States exactly what the register is and that it is kept by the St Petersburg Office for the Yearbook.

gist: Outgoing nos. 1-8, Январь 1899 onwards: five notices to the Printing House of the Imperial Theatres giving addresses and surnames of new subscribers (receipt nos. 14, 19-24, 26-41, 43-47, 49-50); no. 2 forwards waybill 4395 for 700 copies of the 1st book of issue 8 to the Moscow printing house; nos. 6-7 concern a cash-on-delivery parcel of issues 4-7 to Mme D. Bobrova (waybill 2196, 2 r. 40 k.) that went unclaimed.
why: Print-run figure (700 copies of issue 8, book 1) plus the start of the subscriber-notification series.

gist: Lower exposure of the same leaf as p.3 (л.1 recto): repeats nos. 3-5 and shows nos. 6, 7 and 8 in full, which p.3 cuts off. No printed header. Entries recorded under p.3.
why: Same content as p.3; needed only because it completes nos. 6-8.

gist: Outgoing nos. 9-16: cash-on-delivery duplicate waybills 3153 and 3157 to Mr Andrianov and Mr Tkachev for issues 1-6/1-7 and the 1st appendix to issue 8; month heading «Мартъ» at no. 11; lists of subscribers to issue 8 forwarded to the Printing House; no. 13 asks the Steward (Экономъ) of the Imperial Theatres for the alphabetical lists for 1898/1899; headings «Апрѣль» and «Май» follow.
why: Dispatch of back issues and the appendix to issue 8, plus a request for the Yearbook's alphabetical lists.

gist: Lower exposure of the same leaf as p.5 (л.1 verso): repeats the tail of no. 10 and nos. 11-12 and shows nos. 13-16 in full, with the «Апрѣль» and «Май» headings. No printed header. Entries recorded under p.5.
why: Completes nos. 13-16 of p.5.

gist: Outgoing nos. 17-23: no. 18 (28 May) encloses a note with a request to enter ONE FREE COPY in the name of N. N. Petrov; subscriber lists to the Printing House (receipts 66, 93) under the «Іюнь» heading; no. 21 (25 Aug.) forwards waybill 7818 to P. P. Zakharov for issues 6, 7 and 8; nos. 22-23 are letters about dispatches, no. 23 to Mr Adaryukov.
why: A free copy allotted by name is a complimentary/contributor matter; also the named correspondents receiving runs of issues.

gist: Lower exposure of the same leaf as p.7 (л.2 recto): repeats the tail of no. 18 and nos. 19-21 and shows nos. 22-23 in full. No printed header. Entries recorded under p.7.
why: Completes nos. 22-23 of p.7.

gist: Outgoing nos. 17 bis, 18 bis, 19 bis and 24-27. No. 17 bis (13 June) asks the PHOTOGRAPHIC STUDIO of the Imperial Theatres to print photographs per an attached list; 18 bis recalls the unclaimed consignment (waybill 2196) from Saratov via the Nikolaev Railway; 19 bis forwards waybill 14382/1643 for 700 copies of issue 8 plus 2 books of appendices from the Moscow printing house; 24 announces that subscription for issue 9 ceased from 15 June; 25 states the Yearbook began publication in 1890-1891; 26 states issue 8 now costs 5 roubles; 27 pays subscription money for issues 9-10 into the theatres' treasury.
why: Photographs commissioned for the Yearbook, a 700-copy print run with appendices, the price of issue 8 (5 r.), the publication's start date and subscription receipts.

gist: Lower exposure of the same leaf as p.9 (л.2 verso): repeats 19 bis, 24 and 25 and shows nos. 25 (end), 26 and 27 in full, with the «Окт.» heading. No printed header. Entries recorded under p.9.
why: Completes nos. 26-27 of p.9 (price of issue 8; subscription money paid in).

gist: Outgoing nos. 28-31: receipt books issued to the Alexandrinsky Theatre (no. 5), the Mikhailovsky Theatre (no. 6) and the Moscow Office of the Imperial Theatres (nos. 7-11); no. 31 (22 Dec., list of town subscribers to the Printing House) is struck through with a heavy wavy line, with «См. вых. № 39.» in the «Кто принялъ» columns and, at the foot of the page, «По ошибкѣ записано въ 1899 г. вмѣсто 1900 г.»
why: Distribution of subscription receipt books to the individual theatres, and an explicit clerical correction marking the 1899/1900 boundary.

gist: Ruled register page, otherwise blank, with «1900 г.» written large in the middle of the СОДЕРЖАНІЕ column: the year-divider leaf. No entries.
why: Year divider — the file continues past 1899 despite the cover title.

gist: A second ruled, otherwise blank page carrying «1900 г.» in the middle of the СОДЕРЖАНІЕ column; ghost show-through of the next leaf's writing. No entries.
why: Second year-divider leaf; supplies the year for the entries that follow.

gist: Numbering restarts at 1 for 1900. Nos. 1-6: 20 copies of the 3rd book of the appendix to issue 8 sent to the Printing House of the Imperial Theatres (1 April); a letter acknowledging 3 r. 50 k. and saying subscriptions for issue 9 are not yet accepted; waybill 9505 for 1000 COPIES of the 3rd book of the appendix to issue 8 from the Moscow printing house; a letter to the Consumers' Society Board that the Yearbook has not yet appeared; (on the lower exposure) no. 5 asks the Manager of the State Paper Manufacture for a PHOTOGRAPHIC REPRODUCTION of a portrait of the Empress CATHERINE II; no. 6 orders receipt books and subscription advertisements for issues 9 and 10.
why: Print-run figures (20 and 1000 copies of the appendix to issue 8), the delay of issue 9, and an illustration commissioned for the Yearbook.

gist: Lower exposure of the same leaf as p.14: repeats the tail of no. 2 and nos. 3-4 and shows the «Іюнь» and «Августъ» headings with nos. 5 and 6 in full. No printed header. Entries recorded under p.14.
why: Completes nos. 5-6 of p.14, including the Catherine II photographic reproduction.

gist: Outgoing nos. 27-30, all 6 September, plus a December heading with no. 31: receipt books (квитанціонныя книжки) nos. 4-11 covering receipts 151-550 sent to the Mariinsky, Alexandrinsky and Michaelovsky box offices and to the Office of the Imperial Moscow Theatres, for taking subscriptions to issues 9 and 10 of the Yearbook. The block is headed by the note 'Было записано по ошибкѣ въ журналѣ 1899 г.'
why: Dated spine of the subscription machinery: who held which numbered receipt books for selling issues 9 and 10.

gist: Lower exposure of the same leaf as p.16; no item lines are entered for this page - every entry on the leaf is recorded under p.16. Repeats entries 28-30 of p.16 and additionally shows the December heading with outgoing no. 31 entered but with no text in the СОДЕРЖАНІЕ column; that entry has been recorded under p.16. Rest of the leaf blank.
why: Duplicate exposure: triage line only. Its value is that it catches the entries the upper exposure cut off, which are recorded under p.16.

gist: Outgoing nos. 7-11: receipt books sent to the Printing House of the Imperial (Moscow) Theatres - the blank-numbered batch, then 551-600 (25 Oct) and 601-700 (2 Dec); no. 8 (5 Oct) states that issues 9 and 10 cost 3 r. 50 k.; no. 10 (1 Dec) asks the printing house to print 300 receipts to an enclosed specimen.
why: Price of the Yearbook, a print order to the типографія, and the receipt-book series - production and sale figures.

gist: Lower exposure of the same leaf as p.18; no item lines are entered for this page - every entry on the leaf is recorded under p.18. Repeats nos. 9-11 of p.18 and additionally shows nos. 12 (22 Dec) and 13 (30 Dec) - lists of town subscribers to issues 9 and 10 sent to the Moscow theatres and to the printing house, 89 and 13 annual subscriptions; both recorded under p.18.
why: Duplicate exposure: triage line only. Its value is that it catches the entries the upper exposure cut off, which are recorded under p.18.

gist: A duplicate of the opening of p.16's block, written out more fully ('Было записано по ошибкѣ въ журналѣ 1899 г. слѣдующее:' + nos. 27 and 28, receipt books 4 and 5 for the Mariinsky and Alexandrinsky theatres) and then struck through diagonally in blue crayon. Rest of the leaf blank.
why: Cancelled duplicate; useful only as evidence of the clerk's mis-entry into the 1899 journal.

gist: Blank ruled register leaf carrying only the large handwritten year '1901 г.' in the middle - the divider opening the 1901 section of the outgoing journal.
why: Structural divider only, no content.

gist: January 1901, outgoing nos. [1]-5: lists of town subscribers sent to the Printing House of the Imperial Theatres (10, 27 and 29 Jan, the last covering nos. 140-148); no. 2 (19 Jan) forwards a firm's bill no. 530 for certification; no. 5 (30 Jan) asks the Moscow printing house to report the number of subscribers to issues 9 and 10.
why: Subscriber administration plus a printer's bill - money and production.

gist: Lower exposure of the same leaf as p.22; no item lines are entered for this page - every entry on the leaf is recorded under p.22. Repeats nos. 3-5 of p.22 and additionally shows no. 6 (31 Jan, closing the subscription and recalling the receipt books) and no. 7 (3 Feb, asking the St Petersburg Post Office for leave to post 200? copies as registered wrappers at 4 1/2 k. each); both recorded under p.22.
why: Duplicate exposure: triage line only. Its value is that it catches the entries the upper exposure cut off, which are recorded under p.22.

gist: February 1901, outgoing nos. 8-12: 300 cash-on-delivery forms(?) ordered from the printing house (12 Feb); subscribers' addresses (14 Feb, receipts 151-165, 213, 214); coupon book no. 3, receipts 201-300, for selling issues 9 and 10 (17 Feb); 25 copies each of issues 9, 10 and the first supplement sent to Moscow (19 Feb); way-bill for 100 copies of issues 9-10 and 100 of the supplement (23 Feb).
why: Hard quantities: 300 forms, 25 and 100 copies of issues 9-10 and the supplement.

gist: Lower exposure of the same leaf as p.24; no item lines are entered for this page - every entry on the leaf is recorded under p.24. Repeats nos. 10-12 of p.24 and additionally shows no. 13 (25 Feb), the richest entry in this range - a way-bill to the Moscow Office for 3 purchased copies (Теляковскаго, A---невскаго, Бак---шина) and 6 free copies (Теляковскаго, ---ковской, Н. Д. Кашкина, A---невскаго, Маковина?, Силина?); recorded under p.24.
why: Duplicate exposure: triage line only. Its value is that it catches the entries the upper exposure cut off, which are recorded under p.24.

gist: Outgoing nos. 14-18: free copies of all ten issues to the Theatrical Reference and Statistical Bureau (23 Feb); dunning letters to private purchasers (21 Apr, 19 May - the latter an apology to N. E.? Трезвинскій over issues 7 and 8 sent in 1898 and 9 r. charged with postage); 13 Sept replies to A. P. Бабарыкинъ? that supplements 2 and 3 will not be sent separately and that single copies are not sold, and to A. A. Соколовъ that parts 2 and 3 will shortly appear.
why: Free copies to an institution, prices and postage charged to private buyers, and the office's own statements about when the supplements would appear.

gist: Lower exposure of the same leaf as p.26; no item lines are entered for this page - every entry on the leaf is recorded under p.26. Repeats nos. 16-18 of p.26 in full and additionally shows no. 19 (13 Sept) - Count N. Зубовъ? asked to pay a further 1 r. 50 k. for issues 9 and 10; recorded under p.26.
why: Duplicate exposure: triage line only. Its value is that it catches the entries the upper exposure cut off, which are recorded under p.26.

gist: Single entry on an otherwise blank leaf: outgoing no. 20, 19 November, sending 4 receipt books for issues 9 and 10 (from no. 450? and 551-700) to the Printing House of the Imperial Moscow Theatres.
why: Last 1901 entry; shows how little outgoing traffic the Yearbook office generated by then.

gist: Blank ruled register leaf carrying only the large handwritten year '1902.' - the divider opening the 1902 section.
why: Structural divider only, no content.

gist: Last page of the file. A 'Январь.' heading was entered and cancelled with a cross, then 'Февраль'; a single entry, outgoing no. 1 of 14 February 1902, sends the Printing House of the Imperial Moscow Theatres way-bill no. 9237? for 100 copies each of supplements 2 and 3 to issue 10 of the Yearbook.
why: Print-run figure (100 + 100 copies of the supplements) and the file's closing entry.
